name: calculadora
description: Full-stack calculator — Go backend + React/TS frontend. Root orchestration scripts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend:coverage && npm run test:frontend:coverage
scripts.test:backend:coverage: cd backend && go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out && go tool cover -func=coverage.out
scripts.lint: cd backend && go vet ./... && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
